title: Bigelow buys the ranch and starts NIDS monitoring

tellings.quote: And his story actually was brought to the attention of Robert Bigelow.

plain: Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch known for reports of strange events, is said to have been bought by Robert Bigelow in 1996, after the Sherman family's story of what happened there was brought to his attention. Bigelow then had his research group, NIDS, the National Institute for Discovery Science, monitor the place for years. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's current owner, tells Michels how this happened, naming the Shermans and a man named Zack Van Eyk in the chain of people who brought the story to Bigelow.
